unit: WF4 Approval Gate refuses a decision that did not come from the owner chat
description: A well-formed APPROVE arriving from a chat id that is not the Config owner_chat_id must return gate INVALID and must never reach the delivery-identity block, so no send_key, dry_key or communication_id is emitted for it.
why_it_exists: Seed case for the approval-gate adapter, added 2026-08-29 during the SPEC-2 Rev B publication-readiness review. Until then wf4/approval-gate.js was covered only by the three delivery-key families, which assert the derivation block: every gate DECISION was unasserted, so the node AGENTS.md section 1.1 calls the only thing between a model-drafted letter and a real recipient had no executable fail-closed test. Step 1 of the gate is the first refusal in the chain; this pins it, pins the Config passthrough that Verify Selected Row and Gate Result read downstream on a refusal, and pins the absence of a delivery identity on a path that never derived one.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

expect.gate_reason_contains: did not come from the owner chat

assertions: a decision from a chat id other than owner_chat_id returns gate INVALID
the refusal names the owner chat as the reason, so Log Gate Refusal and Telegram - Gate Refused carry it
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys the downstream nodes read (matter_id, approval_id, route_group) survive the refusal untouched
no delivery identity is emitted on a path that refused before the derivation block
